How do I apply to a chamba?
Open the offer in Chambas, check the pay, the district and what they ask for, and tap Apply. The contractor will see your profile and you\'ll get a notice whether you\'re accepted or not.
How do I post a job?
Activate your contractor mode, register your place and create the post with title, pay in soles, district and photos. Only verified contractors can post.
Pay is agreed directly between parties: amount, period and whether it\'s negotiable appear in the post. ChambAYA doesn\'t hold or charge payments.
Why do you verify my ID or tax ID?
So everyone trusts: we validate your identity once with RENIEC or SUNAT. Your document never shows in public, only your name and verification.
Only completed work can be rated, 1 to 5 stars and once per job in each direction. Your average shows on your profile.
How do I report or block someone?
On the post or chat use Report and on the profile use Block. Each report stays under moderation review.
Can I be a worker and a contractor?
Yes, with the same account: your role was set at signup and the other is activated from your profile, without creating another account.
The more data you hide, the higher your level.
Your ID/tax ID and signup email are never public.
just the details you should know.

Summary: ChambAYA connects verified workers and contractors in Ayacucho to offer and find honest work. We verify your identity, protect your data and punish fraud. If you continue, you promise to follow these terms.
A safe space to find chambas
Only accounts verified with ID or tax ID (RENIEC/SUNAT) can post and apply.
Fake posts, unpaid wages, harassment or impersonation are punished with suspension and permanent ban.
Treat everyone kindly and respectfully, honor agreements and show up for accepted jobs.
Describe the real work, pay in soles (PEN), district and people needed. Pay is agreed directly between parties.
Only completed work is rated, 1 to 5 stars and once per job. Fake ratings are removed.
Your ID/tax ID, email and exact address are never public. Only your name, photo, district and reputation show.
You can report posts or users and block contacts. Each report is reviewed by moderation.
One account per person (Worker and Contractor roles in the same user). Don\'t share your password or OTP code.
